prompt:
Our Platform Engineering team needs a quick audit report for an upcoming security review. I need you to extract specific annotated sections from two of our deployment files and save them together into a single plain-text report file called `audit_snippets.txt`.

Here's what I need extracted:

1. From `infra/deploy/deploy.sh`: pull out lines **14 through 28** AND lines **41 through 55**. These cover our validation logic and pre-flight checks.

2. From `config/environments/production.app.conf`: pull out lines **5 through 19** only. This file uses YAML-style syntax even though it has a `.conf` extension, so make sure the tool treats it as YAML for proper formatting. This covers the server configuration block.

The report must show **line numbers** alongside the code and include a **file header** for each section (so reviewers know which file each snippet came from). It must also show any **change markers** if present. The output must be **plain text with no color codes** — it'll be pasted into a Confluence page. All sections should be concatenated into the single `audit_snippets.txt` file.
